name: BTNFT pays vested rewards for unauthorised transfers to itself
summary: BTNFT's _update override skipped the ERC-721 authorisation check whenever the recipient was the contract and paid the token's vested BTT to the caller, so the attacker transferred every holder's NFT to the contract and collected their BTT, 105 days after deployment.
notes: BTT is unpriced; it is valued at the 19,025.94 BSC-USD the attacker sold it for in 0x7978c002, 13 blocks later (rule 12).
